name: The fifth sun
description: New sun joining Mirrodin's four, awakening abilities in its creatures.

description_citations.text: Fifth Dawn: card flavor text (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The fifth sun is born, seen as doom by some and salvation by others.
timeline.quote: To some the birth of the fifth sun was a sign of doom.

citation.text: Channel the Suns (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The fifth sun joins the other four and awakens new abilities in Mirrodin's creatures.
timeline.quote: As the fifth sun joins the other four, new abilities awaken in the creatures of Mirrodin.

citation.text: Suntouched Myr (Fifth Dawn, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
